list.name: sites
list.label: Sucursales
list.query: SELECT store_name AS __text, store_id AS __value FROM sites ORDER BY store_name

panels.title: Facturación
panels.description: Ventas menos devoluciones en el período (ARS).

targets.rawSql: SELECT bucket_day AS time, SUM(amount_minor_sale - amount_minor_return)/100.0 AS "Facturación" FROM pos_by_bucket_day WHERE store_id IN (${sites:sqlstring}) AND bucket_day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date GROUP BY bucket_day ORDER BY time

SELECT bucket_day AS time, SUM(sales)::float / NULLIF(SUM(visits), 0) AS "Conversión" FROM conversion_by_bucket_day WHERE store_id IN (${sites:sqlstring}) AND bucket_day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date GROUP BY bucket_day ORDER BY time

SELECT bucket_day AS time, (SUM(amount_minor_sale) - SUM(amount_minor_return))::float / NULLIF(SUM(sales), 0) / 100.0 AS "Ticket" FROM pos_by_bucket_day WHERE store_id IN (${sites:sqlstring}) AND bucket_day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date GROUP BY bucket_day ORDER BY time

SELECT bucket_day AS time, SUM(items_sale)::float / NULLIF(SUM(sales), 0) AS "UPT" FROM pos_by_bucket_day WHERE store_id IN (${sites:sqlstring}) AND bucket_day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date GROUP BY bucket_day ORDER BY time

SELECT bucket_day AS time, SUM(amount_minor_sale)/100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(ins), 0) AS "RPV" FROM revenue_per_visitor_by_bucket_day WHERE store_id IN (${sites:sqlstring}) AND bucket_day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date GROUP BY bucket_day ORDER BY time

SELECT (bucket_day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires') AS time, SUM(amount_minor_sale - amount_minor_return)/100.0 AS "Facturación" FROM pos_by_bucket_day WHERE store_id IN (${sites:sqlstring}) AND bucket_day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date GROUP BY bucket_day ORDER BY time

panels.title: Tasa de conversión por sucursal
panels.description: Tasa de conversión (compradores ÷ visitantes) por sucursal en el período.

targets.rawSql: SELECT s.store_name AS "Sucursal", SUM(p.sales)::float / NULLIF(SUM(c.ins), 0) AS "Conversión" FROM counting_by_bucket_day c JOIN sites s USING (store_id) LEFT JOIN pos_by_bucket_day p ON c.store_id = p.store_id AND c.bucket_day = p.bucket_day WHERE c.store_id IN (${sites:sqlstring}) AND c.bucket_day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date GROUP BY s.store_name HAVING SUM(c.ins) > 0 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Rendimiento comercial por sucursal
panels.description: Indicadores comerciales por sucursal en el período. Devoluciones = unidades devueltas ÷ vendidas.

targets.rawSql: WITH agg AS (SELECT c.store_id, s.store_name, s.sales_area_m2, SUM(c.ins) ins, SUM(p.sales) sales, (COALESCE(SUM(p.amount_minor_sale),0)-COALESCE(SUM(p.amount_minor_return),0))/100.0 fact, SUM(p.items_sale) it_s, SUM(p.items_return) it_r FROM counting_by_bucket_day c JOIN sites s USING (store_id) LEFT JOIN pos_by_bucket_day p ON c.store_id=p.store_id AND c.bucket_day=p.bucket_day WHERE c.store_id IN (${sites:sqlstring}) AND c.bucket_day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date GROUP BY c.store_id, s.store_name, s.sales_area_m2) SELECT store_name AS "Sucursal", fact AS "Facturación", sales::float/NULLIF(ins,0) AS "Tasa de conversión", fact/NULLIF(sales,0) AS "Ticket promedio", it_s::float/NULLIF(sales,0) AS "UPT", fact/NULLIF(sales_area_m2,0) AS "Ventas/m²", it_r::float/NULLIF(it_s,0) AS "Tasa de devoluciones" FROM agg ORDER BY fact DESC
